ready_rule: width/depth must exactly rebind the frozen accepted I1 Parser claims and provenance records
reviewed derived geometry record must be MANUALLY_CONFIRMED and solver_readiness READY

incoming canonical value, unit, dimension, selected instance, claim ID, derivation rule, input claim IDs, source document, evidence IDs, record digest and claim-graph digest must equal the authoritative record
every input_claim_id must resolve in m2_2_transitive_claim_graph_v1.json
derived input claims must recursively resolve until observed leaves
every observed leaf must carry source_document_sha256, source_page_sha256, source_page_number, sheet_id, bbox_pdf_pt and evidence_id
evidence source_page_sha256 must match the leaf claim source_page_sha256
all leaves must bind to the selected source_document_sha256
derivation rule/version and derivation parameters must be present for derived nodes
any value/identity/edge mismatch blocks admission independently of other blockers
